why: Copy to <so-lanes>/<n>/image-harness.json (beside the lane's debug dir), or point SO_IMAGE_HARNESS at it. Machine values live here, never in scripts. Every key is optional: a scenario or script names what it needs (requires.imageHarness) and is not-runnable without it.

editModels.diffusion: <image-edit diffusion model, exactly as /api/plugins/story-orchestrator-media/discover lists it>

backgroundRemoval: <an alpha recipe id the media plugin offers (discover.alpha[].id)>
raterProfile: <Connection Manager profile of the independent second-model rater (vision-capable)>
controllerUrl: <optional: the GPU residency controller, only for so-image-runtime / saga scripts>

localProfiles.main: <optional: local main profile pinned to controllerUrl>
